name: wit-url-api-showcase
description: wit URL API showcase: static wasm page + Cloudflare Pages host adapter (not published)

scripts.build:wasm: cargo build -p wit-snapshot --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --no-default-features && cp ../../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/wit_snapshot.wasm public/wit_snapshot.wasm
scripts.dev: npm run build:wasm && npm run sync-lib && npx --yes wrangler@4 pages dev public --functions=functions --port=8787
